decisions.decision: Bootstrapped .planning/ by hand instead of running /gsd-new-project
decisions.rationale: The repo had no .planning. /gsd-new-project spawns four research agents to derive context that an 18-minute Codex xhigh audit plus live verification had just established.

decisions.decision: Keep nvidia_entrypoint.sh and pass `vllm serve` as the container command, rather than `docker run --entrypoint vllm`
decisions.rationale: Bypassing the entrypoint discards the image's CUDA environment setup. Now confirmed correct by a live load rather than by inspection alone.

decisions.decision: verify_auth fails closed at the request layer (503), not at startup
decisions.rationale: The installed unit already carries MODEL_MANAGER_ALLOW_UNAUTH=1, so the live service keeps running while an unconfigured deployment refuses mutations.

decisions.decision: Grammar validation AND shlex.quote, not either alone
decisions.rationale: Grammar makes the injection unreachable; quoting is defence-in-depth. The $HOME cache mount is deliberately exempt because it relies on launch-time shell expansion.

decisions.decision: Generated profiles emit no --restart policy at all
decisions.rationale: Josh's call, 2026-08-04. A restart policy on a container whose launch may be wrong converts a bad script into a persistent outage: the broken Qwen3.6 container crash-looped through a reboot holding the name vllm_node, so run-recipe.sh reported 'already running', skipped its launch, and vllm-default-model.service failed. DMM is a manual switcher; the boot unit owns recovery.

decisions.decision: The Qwen3.6 profile delegates to run-recipe.sh instead of replicating its flags
decisions.rationale: Josh's call, 2026-08-04. The recipe applies mods/fix-qwen3.6-chat-template inside the container and passes flags the generator does not emit (--load-format fastsafetensors, --attention-backend flashinfer, --reasoning-parser qwen3, --enable-prefix-caching). Inlining them would fork the source of truth and silently drift. Generalize into a recipe-backed profile type in Phase 3.

decisions.decision: Preflight is static-first, with a container smoke test, and every uncertain check degrades to `skip` rather than `fail`
decisions.rationale: Josh's call, 2026-08-04. Every real launch failure so far was knowable before committing ~100 GB and 3 minutes of weight load. But a preflight that reports false failures — an unresolvable $(...) path, a GPU-less probe that cannot build vLLM's DeviceConfig — trains the reader to ignore it, which is worse than having none.

decisions.decision: Load progress is streamed from `docker logs -f`, not from the /tmp launch log
decisions.rationale: The /tmp log only captures the first foreground attempt: it is near-empty for detached and recipe-backed launches and is wiped by a reboot. That is precisely why the original symptom looked like 'nothing happened'. docker logs is the one source that works for every profile shape and survives a manager restart.

decisions.decision: Derived settings must be hybrid-attention-aware before anything else in Phase 2
decisions.rationale: Measured on this box: a naive num_hidden_layers KV estimate overestimates by 4-11x on every hybrid model here.

context_notes: Phase 1.1 was reactive and unplanned: Josh reported that loading Qwen3.6 from the UI did nothing. Three independent defects were found — a stale profile missing `vllm serve`, a --restart policy that turned that failure into an hour-long outage across a reboot, and page cache being charged against --gpu-memory-utilization. The third is the durable one and is now its own memory (gb10-page-cache-eats-vllm-budget): CUDA reports MemFree rather than MemAvailable, so cached pages are billed against the launch budget. At an unchanged, previously hand-measured util of 0.55, Qwen3.6 got 0.19 GiB of KV cache with ~25 GB cached and 25.97 GiB after drop_caches. This also means MemAvailable-based admission (_vram_admission_check) can pass while the launch still dies in engine init. Phase 2's utilization solver must account for what is already resident, not only what the model needs.
